context.body: Struggle, injury, naming, blessing, and divine identification remain compressed.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: A mysterious man wrestles Jacob, wounds him, renames him Israel, and blesses him.
observations.label: God meets Jacob in struggle: action

observations.body: Jacob refuses release without blessing and says he has seen God face to face.
observations.label: God meets Jacob in struggle: response

observations.body: wrestled · Israel · blessed · face to face
observations.label: Words in Genesis 32:22–32

payload.posture: Read Genesis 32:22–32 as promise and the patriarchs evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The narrator calls the figure a man while Jacob names the encounter as seeing God; the relation is not fully explained here.
payload.title: God meets Jacob in struggle
